Each section opens with the record's reproduction headline and any usage
warning ([label definitions](../eos-labels.md)), then the scope and basis of
the stored check. Only recorded content is shown: missing selections, weights,
errors or conventions are unknown, not zero, and are not inferred. Generating
this page fits nothing and changes no classification or source coefficient.
Every record is also listed by identifier in the
[numerical ledger](../primary-eos-refits.md#records), its
[machine-readable form](https://github.com/CPrescher/peritheos/blob/main/docs/data/primary-eos-refits.json) and the
[source-audit reports](../source-audits.md).

**Curves and residuals** replay the full stored source and reconstructed
coefficients on the same recorded audit inputs. Residual = model − input in
the fitted quantity's native units; for pressure, P(model) − P(input) at each
input volume and temperature (isothermal records use their reference
temperature). RMS is an unweighted descriptive error, not a parameter
uncertainty or the weighted fitting objective. With more than five
temperatures, the minimum, middle and maximum isotherms are drawn; residuals
include every selected row. Error bars appear only where all widths are
recoverable and keep the source meaning, including digitization widths.
No uncertainty band is inferred.

**Coefficient graphs** show stored central values and recorded error widths
in the audit's units; each panel includes zero. They are not observation or
residual plots. Fixed/adopted values are constraints, not recovered values.
Tables round an error to two significant digits when its leading digit is 1
or 2, otherwise one, and the value to the error's decimal place; values
without a positive error show at most six significant digits. Full precision
stays in EOSMAT and the ledger.

## Morard et al. (2026), FeS BM3-MGD

**reproduced** · `fes_vi_morard_2026_bm3_mgd` · `BM3` · [Coefficients and source](../material-summaries/fes_vi.md#record-fes_vi_morard_2026_bm3_mgd)

**Scope:** Comparison with the source parameterization. **Basis:** Conditional parameter agreement under both the combined-error comparison and numerical similarity screen; source confidence conventions remain explicit, and unknown source confidence or shared-data covariance does not become a formal confidence test or author-workflow reproduction.

**Usage:** Accepted for use as the unchanged published common FeS volume relation within the paper's 40-150 GPa scope and observed thermal coverage, with phase, reference-temperature and uncertainty qualifications. The +/-3 GPa envelope is not reproduced and must not be assumed as a prediction-error bound.

- Every compared free coefficient meets both the combined-two-width diagnostic and numerical similarity screen. Source confidence and shared-data covariance are not inferred. Conditional staged cold-then-thermal parameter agreement under the stored EosFit diagnostic and reported widths, whose confidence is unspecified. GUI publication digits, cold-fit pressure scales and the full +/-3 GPa residual envelope remain separate qualifications. Use remains limited to the source's 40-150 GPa scope and observed thermal coverage; coefficient agreement does not establish phase stability or independently change the source-use assessment. Earlier audit wording (superseded only for the named numerical scope): Accepted on parameter agreement under the 2026-10-19 maintainer decision: staged reproduced-cold coefficients are compatible within reported uncertainty intervals, and the equal-weight control puts all four central estimates inside published error widths. The numerical label remains similar, without asserting formal independent uncertainty parity or exact author-workflow reproduction. The unreproduced +/-3 GPa residual envelope is informational and does not gate catalog use. Published coefficients are preserved. Published BM3-MGD coefficients accepted unchanged on parameter agreement, following the 2026-10-19 maintainer decision. The confirmed selected author input has 21 literature cold and 146 thermal rows, excluding all 11 unsuitable quenched rows. Weighted and equal-weight cold-then-thermal EosFit fits recover all three cold coefficients within published error widths; equal-weight gamma0 is inside the published width and the weighted gamma0 interval overlaps it. Actual distributed-GUI fits agree closely with the console. Reconstruction remains classified similar: source error confidence and cross-fit covariance are unspecified and thermal errors condition on fixed cold coefficients. The staged weighted GUI thermal replay has RMS 1.63 GPa, maximum 5.29 GPa, and 12/146 rows outside +/-3 GPa. This residual-reporting discrepancy does not block use; exact original author-workflow reproduction is not claimed. See docs/literature-reproductions/fes-gui-replay.md and docs/literature-reproductions/fes-eosfit-direct.md.
- Published BM3-MGD coefficients accepted unchanged on parameter agreement, following the 2026-10-19 maintainer decision. The confirmed selected author input has 21 literature cold and 146 thermal rows, excluding all 11 unsuitable quenched rows. Weighted and equal-weight cold-then-thermal EosFit fits recover all three cold coefficients within published error widths; equal-weight gamma0 is inside the published width and the weighted gamma0 interval overlaps it. Actual distributed-GUI fits agree closely with the console. See docs/literature-reproductions/fes-gui-replay.md and docs/literature-reproductions/fes-eosfit-direct.md.

The +/-3 GPa envelope is not reproduced and must not be assumed as a prediction-error bound.
- exact original 20210609 GUI build and regression controls
- published +/-3 GPa envelope versus staged weighted GUI maximum 5.29 GPa (informational; does not block use)
- individual provenance and pressure calibration of all 21 literature cold rows
- source error confidence and cross-fit/cold-to-thermal covariance

### Method

- **Dataset identifiers:** fes\_morard\_2026\_author\_without\_additional\_cold\_pvt
- **Observations:** 167
- **Fit kind:** cold\_then\_fixed\_cold\_thermal
- **Objective:** EosFit pressure residuals with supplied P/V/T uncertainty weights
- **Free parameters:** eos.V0; eos.K0; eos.K0\_prime; thermal.gamma0
- **Fixed parameters:** theta0; q; n; Tr=300 K
